research.name: dtui
research.note: Terminal browser for D-Bus services with an object tree and a method call form that checks typed arguments.

effects: method call form whose argument fields turn green when the text parses against the D-Bus type signature
four-pane layout: services list, collapsible object/interface/method tree, results log, call form with per-argument inputs
